items.notes: Generated container-safe converge.yml. Creates full HAProxy filesystem layout under /tmp/molecule_test/ including: directory tree (etc/haproxy, conf.d, errors, var/lib/haproxy, logrotate.d), main haproxy.cfg with SSL+stats+stick-table scenario, three backend fragments (webservers/api/internal_monitoring), stick-tables.cfg, custom error pages (503/408), and logrotate config. No become, no include_role, all paths under /tmp/molecule_test/.

items.description: Verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths: haproxy.cfg, conf.d/webservers.cfg, conf.d/api.cfg, errors/503.http, errors/408.http, logrotate config
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 6 plays to stay under 15-task limit per play. Play 1: directory stat+assert. Play 2: all config file stat+assert (existence+non-empty). Play 3: main haproxy.cfg content assertions (global/defaults/frontend/SSL/stats/errorfile). Play 4: backend fragment content assertions (webservers/api/internal_monitoring/stick-tables). Play 5: error pages and logrotate content assertions. Play 6: service/port/HTTP checks all tagged molecule-notest (container-unsafe). All loops use prefixed loop_vars and bracket notation. No untrusted vars in fail_msg strings.
